005package org.wpilib.telemetry;
006
007import java.util.ArrayList;
008import java.util.Collection;
009import java.util.Collections;
010import java.util.IdentityHashMap;
011import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
012import java.util.List;
013import java.util.Map;
014import java.util.Set;
015import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
016import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentMap;
017import java.util.function.BiConsumer;

022/** Global registry for telemetry handlers (type handlers and telemetry backends). */
023public final class TelemetryRegistry {
024  /**
025   * Handler for logging objects of specific type. Typically only one handler is specified.
026   *
027   * @param <T> object type
028   */
029  @FunctionalInterface
030  public interface TypeHandler<T> {
031    /**
032     * Log value to table as/under name.
033     *
034     * @param table telemetry table
035     * @param name name
036     * @param value value
037     */
038    void logTo(TelemetryTable table, String name, T value);
039  }
040
041  /**
042   * Storage for handler for logging objects of specific type.
043   *
044   * @param cls class this handler applies to
045   * @param handler handler for logging
046   */
047  private record TypeHandlerData<T>(Class<T> cls, TypeHandler<T> handler) {}
048
049  private record BackendPrefix(String prefix, TelemetryBackend backend) {}
050
051  private record RemovedEntry(TelemetryBackend backend, String path) {}
052
053  private static final class EntryMetadata {
054    private final Map<String, String> m_properties = new LinkedHashMap<>();
055    private boolean m_keepDuplicates;
056
057    synchronized void keepDuplicates() {
058      m_keepDuplicates = true;
059    }
060
061    synchronized void setProperty(String key, String value) {
062      m_properties.put(key, value);
063    }
064
065    void apply(TelemetryEntry entry) {
066      boolean keepDuplicates;
067      Map<String, String> properties;
068      synchronized (this) {
069        keepDuplicates = m_keepDuplicates;
070        properties = new LinkedHashMap<>(m_properties);
071      }
072
073      if (keepDuplicates) {
074        entry.keepDuplicates();
075      }
076      for (var property : properties.entrySet()) {
077        entry.setProperty(property.getKey(), property.getValue());
078      }
079    }
080  }
081
082  private static final List<TypeHandlerData<?>> s_typeHandlers = new ArrayList<>();
083  private static final PrefixMap<TelemetryBackend> s_backends = new StringPrefixMap<>();
084  private static final Map<String, TelemetryBackend> s_entryBackends = new LinkedHashMap<>();
085  private static final ConcurrentMap<String, TelemetryTable> s_tables = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
086  private static final ConcurrentMap<String, EntryMetadata> s_entryMetadata =
087      new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
088  private static final TelemetryBackend s_missingBackend = new DiscardTelemetryBackend();
089  private static BiConsumer<String, String> s_reportWarning =
090      TelemetryRegistry::defaultReportWarning;
091
092  private TelemetryRegistry() {
093    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This is a utility class!");
094  }
095
096  private static void defaultReportWarning(String path, String msg) {
097    // TODO: do something smarter here
098    StackTraceElement[] stackTrace = Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace();
099    StringBuilder traceString = new StringBuilder();
100    for (int i = 1; i < stackTrace.length; i++) {
101      String loc = stackTrace[i].toString();
102      traceString.append("\tat ").append(loc).append('\n');
103    }
104
105    System.err.println("Telemetry '" + path + "': warning: " + msg + "\n" + traceString.toString());
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * Set function used for reporting warning messages (e.g. type mismatches).
110   *
111   * <p>The reporting function may be called concurrently and must not throw.
112   *
113   * @param func reporting function; parameters are path and message; pass null to use default
114   */
115  public static void setReportWarning(BiConsumer<String, String> func) {
116    synchronized (TelemetryRegistry.class) {
117      if (func == null) {
118        s_reportWarning = TelemetryRegistry::defaultReportWarning;
119      } else {
120        s_reportWarning = func;
121      }
122    }
123  }
124
125  /**
126   * Get function used for reporting warning messages.
127   *
128   * @return reporting function
129   */
130  public static BiConsumer<String, String> getReportWarning() {
131    synchronized (TelemetryRegistry.class) {
132      return s_reportWarning;
133    }
134  }
135
136  /**
137   * Report a warning message (e.g. type mismatch).
138   *
139   * @param path entry path
140   * @param msg warning message
141   */
142  public static void reportWarning(String path, String msg) {
143    synchronized (TelemetryRegistry.class) {
144      s_reportWarning.accept(path, msg);
145    }
146  }
147
148  /**
149   * Registers a handler for logging objects of a particular type. The handler should populate the
150   * provided TelemetryTable name as appropriate for the object's data.
151   *
152   * @param <T> class
153   * @param cls class object
154   * @param handler handler (accepts TelemetryTable, entry name, and object)
155   */
156  public static <T> void registerTypeHandler(Class<T> cls, TypeHandler<T> handler) {
157    synchronized (s_typeHandlers) {
158      // we want this ordered such that the more specific types come before the less specific ones
159      // this is O(N^2) but N should be small
160      boolean replace = false;
161      int i = 0;
162      for (var entry : s_typeHandlers) {
163        if (entry.cls.equals(cls)) {
164          // replace existing
165          replace = true;
166          break;
167        }
168        if (entry.cls.isAssignableFrom(cls)) {
169          // superclass; insert before
170          break;
171        }
172        i++;
173      }
174
175      if (replace) {
176        s_typeHandlers.set(i, new TypeHandlerData<>(cls, handler));
177      } else {
178        s_typeHandlers.add(i, new TypeHandlerData<>(cls, handler));
179      }
180    }
181  }
182
183  /**
184   * Registers a backend for creating telemetry entries. When calling getEntry(), the longest prefix
185   * match is used.
186   *
187   * @param prefix prefix for entries covered by this backend
188   * @param backend backend
189   */
190  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
191  public static void registerBackend(String prefix, TelemetryBackend backend) {
192    String normalizedPrefix = PathUtil.normalizeBackendPrefix(prefix);
193    List<RemovedEntry> removedEntries = new ArrayList<>();
194    List<TelemetryBackend> registeredBackends = new ArrayList<>();
195    Set<TelemetryBackend> registeredOwnedBackends =
196        Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
197    Set<TelemetryBackend> displacedBackends = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
198    synchronized (s_backends) {
199      // Reset table generations before backend routing changes become visible.
200      for (var table : s_tables.values()) {
201        table.reset();
202      }
203
204      TelemetryBackend oldBackend = s_backends.put(normalizedPrefix, backend);
205      if (oldBackend != null) {
206        displacedBackends.add(oldBackend);
207      }
208
209      for (var iterator = s_entryBackends.entrySet().iterator(); iterator.hasNext(); ) {
210        var entry = iterator.next();
211        TelemetryBackend newBackend = getBackendForNormalizedPath(entry.getKey());
212        if (entry.getValue() != newBackend) {
213          removedEntries.add(new RemovedEntry(entry.getValue(), entry.getKey()));
214          iterator.remove();
215        }
216      }
217      registeredBackends.addAll(s_backends.values());
218      for (TelemetryBackend registeredBackend : registeredBackends) {
219        collectOwnedBackends(registeredBackend, registeredOwnedBackends);
220      }
221    }
222    removeBackendsSharingOwnershipWith(displacedBackends, registeredBackends);
223
224    try {
225      for (var entry : removedEntries) {
226        entry.backend().removeEntry(entry.path());
227      }
228    } finally {
229      closeBackends(displacedBackends, registeredOwnedBackends);
230    }
231  }
232
233  /**
234   * Gets the handler for logging an object. Should generally only be used by TelemetryTable.
235   *
236   * @param <T> class
237   * @param value value
238   * @return handler or null if no match
239   */
240  public static <T> TypeHandler<T> getTypeHandler(T value) {
241    synchronized (s_typeHandlers) {
242      for (var entry : s_typeHandlers) {
243        if (entry.cls.isInstance(value)) {
244          @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
245          TypeHandler<T> handler = (TypeHandler<T>) entry.handler;
246          return handler;
247        }
248      }
249      return null;
250    }
251  }
252
253  /**
254   * Gets the backend for logging an object. Should generally only be used internally or by custom
255   * backends.
256   *
257   * @param path full name
258   * @return telemetry backend, or a discard backend if no match
259   */
260  public static TelemetryBackend getBackend(String path) {
261    String normalized = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
262    TelemetryBackend backend;
263    synchronized (s_backends) {
264      backend = getBackendForNormalizedPath(normalized);
265    }
266    if (backend == null) {
267      reportWarning(normalized, "no backend for path");
268      return s_missingBackend;
269    }
270    return backend;
271  }
272
273  /**
274   * Get a telemetry entry for a particular name.
275   *
276   * @param path full name
277   * @return telemetry entry
278   */
279  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
280  static TelemetryEntry getEntry(String path) {
281    String normalized = PathUtil.normalizeName(path);
282    for (; ; ) {
283      TelemetryBackend backend;
284      boolean missingBackend = false;
285      synchronized (s_backends) {
286        backend = getBackendForNormalizedPath(normalized);
287        if (backend == null) {
288          backend = s_missingBackend;
289          missingBackend = true;
290        }
291      }
292      if (missingBackend) {
293        reportWarning(normalized, "no backend for path");
294      }
295
296      TelemetryEntry entry = backend.getEntry(normalized);
297      synchronized (s_backends) {
298        TelemetryBackend currentBackend = getBackendForNormalizedPath(normalized);
299        if (currentBackend == null) {
300          currentBackend = s_missingBackend;
301        }
302        if (backend == currentBackend) {
303          s_entryBackends.put(normalized, backend);
304          return entry;
305        }
306      }
307
308      backend.removeEntry(normalized);
309    }
310  }
311
312  static void keepEntryDuplicates(String path) {
313    s_entryMetadata
314        .computeIfAbsent(PathUtil.normalizeName(path), k -> new EntryMetadata())
315        .keepDuplicates();
316  }
317
318  static void setEntryProperty(String path, String key, String value) {
319    s_entryMetadata
320        .computeIfAbsent(PathUtil.normalizeName(path), k -> new EntryMetadata())
321        .setProperty(key, value);
322  }
323
324  static void applyEntryMetadata(String path, TelemetryEntry entry) {
325    EntryMetadata metadata = s_entryMetadata.get(PathUtil.normalizeName(path));
326    if (metadata != null) {
327      metadata.apply(entry);
328    }
329  }
330
331  static boolean hasNonDiscardDescendant(String tablePath) {
332    String normalized = PathUtil.normalizeTableName(tablePath);
333    List<BackendPrefix> descendants = new ArrayList<>();
334    synchronized (s_backends) {
335      for (Map.Entry<String, TelemetryBackend> entry : s_backends.entrySet()) {
336        if (PathUtil.isPathOrDescendant(entry.getKey(), normalized)) {
337          descendants.add(new BackendPrefix(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue()));
338        }
339      }
340    }
341
342    for (BackendPrefix descendant : descendants) {
343      if (!descendant.backend().getEntry(descendant.prefix()).isDiscard()) {
344        return true;
345      }
346    }
347    return false;
348  }
349
350  /**
351   * Get a telemetry table for a particular name.
352   *
353   * @param path full name
354   * @return telemetry table
355   */
356  public static TelemetryTable getTable(String path) {
357    return s_tables.computeIfAbsent(PathUtil.normalizeTableName(path), TelemetryTable::new);
358  }
359
360  /**
361   * Clear all registered types and backends and closes all entries. Should typically only be used
362   * by unit test code.
363   */
364  public static void reset() {
365    List<RemovedEntry> removedEntries = new ArrayList<>();
366    Set<TelemetryBackend> backends = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
367    synchronized (s_typeHandlers) {
368      s_typeHandlers.clear();
369    }
370    synchronized (s_backends) {
371      // Reset table generations before backend routing changes become visible.
372      for (var table : s_tables.values()) {
373        table.reset();
374      }
375
376      for (var entry : s_entryBackends.entrySet()) {
377        removedEntries.add(new RemovedEntry(entry.getValue(), entry.getKey()));
378      }
379      backends.addAll(s_backends.values());
380      s_backends.clear();
381      s_entryBackends.clear();
382    }
383    removeBackendsOwnedByOtherBackends(backends);
384
385    for (var entry : removedEntries) {
386      entry.backend().removeEntry(entry.path());
387    }
388    closeBackends(backends, Collections.emptySet());
389    s_entryMetadata.clear();
390  }
391
392  private static TelemetryBackend getBackendForNormalizedPath(String path) {
393    String candidate = path;
394    while (true) {
395      TelemetryBackend backend = s_backends.get(candidate);
396      if (backend != null) {
397        return backend;
398      }
399
400      int slash = candidate.lastIndexOf('/');
401      if (slash <= 0) {
402        break;
403      }
404      candidate = candidate.substring(0, slash);
405    }
406
407    TelemetryBackend rootBackend = s_backends.get("/");
408    if (rootBackend != null) {
409      return rootBackend;
410    }
411    return s_backends.get("");
412  }
413
414  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
415  private static void closeBackends(
416      Collection<TelemetryBackend> backends, Set<TelemetryBackend> skipBackends) {
417    Set<TelemetryBackend> closedBackends = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
418    for (TelemetryBackend backend : backends) {
419      try {
420        closeBackend(backend, closedBackends, skipBackends);
421      } catch (Exception e) {
422        System.out.println("Unexpected exception when closing backend: " + e);
423      }
424    }
425  }
426
427  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.SignatureDeclareThrowsException")
428  static void closeBackend(
429      TelemetryBackend backend,
430      Set<TelemetryBackend> closedBackends,
431      Set<TelemetryBackend> skipBackends)
432      throws Exception {
433    if (skipBackends.contains(backend) || closedBackends.contains(backend)) {
434      return;
435    }
436    if (backend instanceof MultiTelemetryBackend multiBackend) {
437      multiBackend.close(closedBackends, skipBackends);
438      return;
439    }
440    closedBackends.add(backend);
441    backend.close();
442  }
443
444  static void collectOwnedBackends(TelemetryBackend backend, Set<TelemetryBackend> ownedBackends) {
445    if (backend instanceof MultiTelemetryBackend multiBackend) {
446      multiBackend.collectOwnedBackends(ownedBackends);
447    } else {
448      ownedBackends.add(backend);
449    }
450  }
451
452  private static void removeBackendsSharingOwnershipWith(
453      Set<TelemetryBackend> candidateBackends, Iterable<TelemetryBackend> ownerBackends) {
454    for (TelemetryBackend ownerBackend : ownerBackends) {
455      for (var iterator = candidateBackends.iterator(); iterator.hasNext(); ) {
456        TelemetryBackend candidateBackend = iterator.next();
457        if (candidateBackend instanceof MultiTelemetryBackend) {
458          continue;
459        }
460        if (ownerBackend.sharesBackendWith(candidateBackend)) {
461          iterator.remove();
462        }
463      }
464    }
465  }
466
467  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.CompareObjectsWithEquals")
468  private static void removeBackendsOwnedByOtherBackends(Set<TelemetryBackend> candidateBackends) {
469    List<TelemetryBackend> ownerBackends = new ArrayList<>(candidateBackends);
470    for (TelemetryBackend ownerBackend : ownerBackends) {
471      for (var iterator = candidateBackends.iterator(); iterator.hasNext(); ) {
472        TelemetryBackend candidateBackend = iterator.next();
473        if (ownerBackend != candidateBackend && ownerBackend.ownsBackend(candidateBackend)) {
474          iterator.remove();
475        }
476      }
477    }
478  }
479}
